en-US: Add a Windows x64 Preview with secure automatic updates; unsigned builds may show a Windows security warning, so download only from the official EdgeEver Release.
Keep personal self-hosted instances aligned with each official Release automatically.
Reduce redundant demo seed writes to improve API reliability and database efficiency.

个人自托管实例现在会随每个官方 Release 自动同步部署。
